globalRules: The deterministic gate verifies source eligibility and exact quotation, not semantic correctness.
Self-correction, valid alternatives and dimension separation remain semantic evaluator responsibilities.
A help request is not a demonstrated incorrect answer.
Professor/reference speech is never learner evidence.
Transcript-only evaluation cannot establish pronunciation, accent, pause timing or acoustic fluency.
No case in this file is a real model result, learner result or mastery score.
